# Human Variance

## The requirement

> status: ratified (D-0057, D-0058)

Everyone in this world is human — no literal dwarves, elves, wizards-as-species, or
orcs — but humans must vary in ways the listener can grasp, possibly beyond the
ordinary in mental capacity. Difference is defined by circumstance: geography, labor,
economic position, educational opportunity, and values — never by modern
identity-category shorthand. The author explicitly flagged doubt about
"monster-type proxies": if near-inhuman figures exist at all, they must earn their
place, not import a fantasy-race template.

## The variance scheme

> status: ratified (D-0118)

Four kinds of variance, each of them circumstance written on the body, never species
(D-0058). The sheltered ("chalk-blooded"): keep-raised, pale and fragile, shielded from the
raw Wyrd and drilled for ledger-work. The spent ("bog-touched"): extraction-zone labourers,
dense-boned and grey-callused, lungs adapted to filter foul air, worn down early by the work
that shaped them. The Wyrd-marked ("liminal"): people the land itself has written. And a
fourth, the Archive-condition of the protagonist ([[protagonist]]): great cognition is the mark the
Tithe leaves on a body it has used, costs and all. The labels stay working
descriptors, not proper names (Q-0002).

How liminality is made is settled on a single gauge: it is **debt-written** — axiomatic debt
inscribes a person the way it sours a spring, a spectrum that is reversible early and fixed
late, read on the very measure that reads soured soil and sick beasts. That
shared gauge is exactly what keeps liminals out of "monster proxy" territory (D-0105/D-0058).
Two variants ride on it: **heritable lineages** (families who lived for generations at fouled
human/landvættir edges, the mark running in the blood) and the **treaty-touched** (the
honoured cost and gift of someone who entered deep treaty with a landvættir). What a mark
*means* is decided by whoever reads the body: to the empire, witchery or a tool; to the
natives, kin or the sacred.

## Liminal-style figures: approved and schemed

> status: ratified (D-0105, D-0118)

The author's earlier hesitation ("not sure we're doing monster proxies") resolved in favour:
liminal-style figures are IN, as are magical animals ([[animals]]). The concrete scheme is
now settled too (D-0118, above): liminality is debt-written on the shared axiomatic-debt
gauge, with heritable and treaty-touched variants, and it reads with real nuance, well clear
of any monster category — honouring both D-0105's demand for nuance and the D-0058 no-races
rule.

## Why it matters either way

> status: ratified (D-0057)

The scheme's narrative job is fixed: variance must dramatize
class and circumstance — who was sheltered, who was spent, who was cast out — so that
bodies themselves quietly testify to what the system does to people.
